summary: The verifier packet shows QEMU was launched in the background with console redirection to `telnet:127.0.0.1:6665` (`qemu-system-x86_64 ... -serial telnet:127.0.0.1:6665,server,nowait ... > qemu.log 2>&1 &`, plus `qemu.pid`). It also shows a later telnet/expect probe (`step-5:a-0:cmd`) exited 0, but the actual transcript content for `5:a-0:stdout` is not available to me in this inspection surface, so I cannot directly confirm that the guest login prompt appeared, nor can I independently verify post-probe liveness. A read-only transcript/probe inspection capability is required to complete the verdict.
